set.body:
Scope: modules/atlas, atlas examples/workflows/publication adapters and known external consumers.

Deliverable: Cut all atlas consumers over to neuroatlas4s public APIs, move owned assets/fixtures/generators/docs and remove old module sources and aliases. Leave only functional workflow composition in ScalaFIM.

Acceptance:
- Atlas workflows and independent consumers run against the extracted revision; generic MVPA atlas integration has a defined U6 destination.
- No duplicate atlas implementation, frame catalog, parcellation engine or asset fixture copy remains.
- Persisted publication/scene tags and source/license/citation evidence survive; affected JVM/JS tests and example builds pass.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: A1: Migrate atlas callers and delete the ScalaFIM atlas implementation
